	base_revision INTEGER, 
	domain_kind VARCHAR(30), 
	domain_run_id CHAR(32), 
	completion_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_state CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval','paused','cancel_requested','completed','failed','cancelled','interrupted')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_number UNIQUE (run_id, number), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_positive CHECK (number > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_retry_key UNIQUE (run_id, retry_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_budget_accounts" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	scope_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	cost_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempt_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_scope CHECK (scope_kind IN ('owner','project','workspace','run')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_hard_limits CHECK (reserved_cost + consumed_cost <= cost_limit AND attempts <= attempt_limit AND reserved_tokens + consumed_tokens <= token_limit AND reserved_ms + consumed_ms <= time_limit_ms), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_budget_scope UNIQUE (owner_id, scope_kind, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_nonnegative CHECK (cost_limit > 0 AND attempt_limit > 0 AND token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0 AND reserved_cost >= 0 AND consumed_cost >= 0 AND attempts >= 0 AND reserved_tokens >= 0 AND consumed_tokens >= 0 AND reserved_ms >= 0 AND consumed_ms >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_charges" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	approval_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	call_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	account_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	specification_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	input_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	output_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	used_cost BIGINT, 
	used_tokens BIGINT, 
	used_ms BIGINT, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	settlement_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_charge_call UNIQUE (run_id, call_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_limits CHECK ((used_cost IS NULL OR (used_cost >= 0 AND used_cost <= reserved_cost)) AND (used_tokens IS NULL OR (used_tokens >= 0 AND used_tokens <= input_token_limit + output_token_limit)) AND (used_ms IS NULL OR (used_ms >= 0 AND used_ms <= time_limit_ms))), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_reservation CHECK (reserved_cost > 0 AND input_token_limit > 0 AND output_token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_proof CHECK ((state IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NOT NULL AND used_tokens IS NOT NULL AND used_ms IS NOT NULL AND settlement_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (state NOT IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NULL AND used_tokens IS NULL AND used_ms IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','dispatched','unknown','settled','released')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES research_approvals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_credential_operations (

	namespace VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	configuration_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	result_code VARCHAR(40), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, producer_instance VARCHAR(80), producer_pid INTEGER, producer_birth VARCHAR(64), lease_until_ms BIGINT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_credential_kind CHECK (kind IN ('create','delete')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_credential_state CHECK (state IN ('intent','confirmed','cleanup_pending','failed','deleted')),

)

CREATE TABLE research_events (

	entity_kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	previous_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	chain_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	hash_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id),

	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id),

CREATE TABLE research_execution_dispatches (

	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_dispatch_identity CHECK (fence > 0 AND registered_at_ms > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_execution_intents (attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_intents (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	intent_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	domain_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	staging_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_intent_fence CHECK (fence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id), 
	UNIQUE (intent_hash), 
	UNIQUE (domain_id), 
	UNIQUE (staging_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_leases (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	worker_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	producer_host VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	producer_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	producer_birth VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	claimed_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lease_until_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	active_slot INTEGER, 
	released_at_ms BIGINT, result_only BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_execution_global_slot UNIQUE (active_slot), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_identity CHECK (fence > 0 AND producer_pid > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_times CHECK (claimed_at_ms > 0 AND heartbeat_at_ms >= claimed_at_ms AND lease_until_ms > heartbeat_at_ms AND (released_at_ms IS NULL OR released_at_ms >= claimed_at_ms)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_active_slot CHECK ((released_at_ms IS NULL AND active_slot = 1 AND active_slot IS NOT NULL) OR (released_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND active_slot IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_receipts (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_receipt_bytes CHECK (result_bytes > 0 AND result_bytes <= 16777216), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_execution_intents (attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_messages (

	run_id CHAR(32),

CREATE TABLE research_provider_configurations (

CREATE TABLE research_provider_events (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entity_kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	previous_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	chain_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	hash_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE research_provider_states (

	current_id CHAR(32),

CREATE TABLE research_publication_intents (

CREATE TABLE research_publication_receipts (

CREATE TABLE research_runs (
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	input_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_completed_proof CHECK (state != 'completed' OR (completion_hash IS NOT NULL AND domain_run_id IS NOT NULL AND domain_kind IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_run_state CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval','paused','cancel_requested','completed','failed','cancelled','interrupted')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_run_counters CHECK (revision >= 0 AND attempt_count >= 0),

CREATE TABLE research_sessions (

CREATE TABLE stat_results (

	p_value FLOAT, 
	alternative VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

	effect_size_json TEXT,

	result_json TEXT, 
	software_versions_json TEXT,

	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "research_approvals" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	policy_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	consumed_charge_id CHAR(32), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_expiry CHECK (expires_at_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_approval_proposal UNIQUE (run_id, proposal_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','approved','denied','revoked','consumed')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_consumed CHECK ((state = 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NOT NULL) OR (state != 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(policy_id) REFERENCES research_policies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_artifact_edges (
	parent_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	child_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	relation VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_artifact_no_self_edge CHECK (parent_id != child_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(child_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_artifact_edge UNIQUE (parent_id, child_id, relation)
)

CREATE TABLE research_artifacts (
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	project_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(127) NOT NULL, 
	byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	object_key VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_artifact_nonempty CHECK (byte_size > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id), 
	UNIQUE (object_key)
)

CREATE TABLE research_attachments (
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	target_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_project_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attachment_version_required CHECK ((target_kind = 'project' AND target_sha256 IS NULL) OR (target_kind != 'project' AND target_sha256 IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attachment_kind CHECK (target_kind IN ('project','dataset_version','artifact')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES research_sessions (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attachment UNIQUE (session_id, target_kind, target_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_attempts" (
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(100), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	retry_key VARCHAR(200), 
	base_revision INTEGER, 
	domain_kind VARCHAR(30), 
	domain_run_id CHAR(32), 
	completion_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_state CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval','paused','cancel_requested','completed','failed','cancelled','interrupted')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_number UNIQUE (run_id, number), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_positive CHECK (number > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_retry_key UNIQUE (run_id, retry_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

	consumed_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_scope CHECK (scope_kind IN ('owner','project','workspace','run')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_hard_limits CHECK (reserved_cost + consumed_cost <= cost_limit AND attempts <= attempt_limit AND reserved_tokens + consumed_tokens <= token_limit AND reserved_ms + consumed_ms <= time_limit_ms), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_budget_scope UNIQUE (owner_id, scope_kind, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_nonnegative CHECK (cost_limit > 0 AND attempt_limit > 0 AND token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0 AND reserved_cost >= 0 AND consumed_cost >= 0 AND attempts >= 0 AND reserved_tokens >= 0 AND consumed_tokens >= 0 AND reserved_ms >= 0 AND consumed_ms >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_charges" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	approval_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	call_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	account_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	specification_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	input_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	output_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	used_cost BIGINT, 
	used_tokens BIGINT, 
	used_ms BIGINT, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	settlement_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_charge_call UNIQUE (run_id, call_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_limits CHECK ((used_cost IS NULL OR (used_cost >= 0 AND used_cost <= reserved_cost)) AND (used_tokens IS NULL OR (used_tokens >= 0 AND used_tokens <= input_token_limit + output_token_limit)) AND (used_ms IS NULL OR (used_ms >= 0 AND used_ms <= time_limit_ms))), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_reservation CHECK (reserved_cost > 0 AND input_token_limit > 0 AND output_token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_proof CHECK ((state IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NOT NULL AND used_tokens IS NOT NULL AND used_ms IS NOT NULL AND settlement_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (state NOT IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NULL AND used_tokens IS NULL AND used_ms IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','dispatched','unknown','settled','released')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES research_approvals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_approvals" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	policy_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	consumed_charge_id CHAR(32), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_expiry CHECK (expires_at_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_approval_proposal UNIQUE (run_id, proposal_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','approved','denied','revoked','consumed')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_consumed CHECK ((state = 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NOT NULL) OR (state != 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(policy_id) REFERENCES research_policies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_artifact_edges (
	parent_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	child_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	relation VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_artifact_no_self_edge CHECK (parent_id != child_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(child_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_artifact_edge UNIQUE (parent_id, child_id, relation)
)

CREATE TABLE research_artifacts (
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT research_artifact_nonempty CHECK (byte_size > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id), 
	UNIQUE (object_key)
)

CREATE TABLE research_attachments (
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	target_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_project_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attachment_version_required CHECK ((target_kind = 'project' AND target_sha256 IS NULL) OR (target_kind != 'project' AND target_sha256 IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attachment_kind CHECK (target_kind IN ('project','dataset_version','artifact')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES research_sessions (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attachment UNIQUE (session_id, target_kind, target_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_attempts" (
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(100), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	retry_key VARCHAR(200), 
	base_revision INTEGER, 
	domain_kind VARCHAR(30), 
	domain_run_id CHAR(32), 
	completion_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_state CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval','paused','cancel_requested','completed','failed','cancelled','interrupted')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_number UNIQUE (run_id, number), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_positive CHECK (number > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_retry_key UNIQUE (run_id, retry_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_budget_accounts" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	scope_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	cost_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempt_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_scope CHECK (scope_kind IN ('owner','project','workspace','run')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_hard_limits CHECK (reserved_cost + consumed_cost <= cost_limit AND attempts <= attempt_limit AND reserved_tokens + consumed_tokens <= token_limit AND reserved_ms + consumed_ms <= time_limit_ms), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_budget_scope UNIQUE (owner_id, scope_kind, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_nonnegative CHECK (cost_limit > 0 AND attempt_limit > 0 AND token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0 AND reserved_cost >= 0 AND consumed_cost >= 0 AND attempts >= 0 AND reserved_tokens >= 0 AND consumed_tokens >= 0 AND reserved_ms >= 0 AND consumed_ms >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_charges" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	approval_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	call_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	account_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	specification_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	input_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	output_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	used_cost BIGINT, 
	used_tokens BIGINT, 
	used_ms BIGINT, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	settlement_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_charge_call UNIQUE (run_id, call_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_limits CHECK ((used_cost IS NULL OR (used_cost >= 0 AND used_cost <= reserved_cost)) AND (used_tokens IS NULL OR (used_tokens >= 0 AND used_tokens <= input_token_limit + output_token_limit)) AND (used_ms IS NULL OR (used_ms >= 0 AND used_ms <= time_limit_ms))), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_reservation CHECK (reserved_cost > 0 AND input_token_limit > 0 AND output_token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_proof CHECK ((state IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NOT NULL AND used_tokens IS NOT NULL AND used_ms IS NOT NULL AND settlement_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (state NOT IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NULL AND used_tokens IS NULL AND used_ms IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','dispatched','unknown','settled','released')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES research_approvals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_credential_operations (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	namespace VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	configuration_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	result_code VARCHAR(40), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, producer_instance VARCHAR(80), producer_pid INTEGER, producer_birth VARCHAR(64), lease_until_ms BIGINT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_credential_kind CHECK (kind IN ('create','delete')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_credential_state CHECK (state IN ('intent','confirmed','cleanup_pending','failed','deleted')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_events (
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entity_kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	previous_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	chain_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	hash_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_event_positive CHECK (sequence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES research_workspaces (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_event_sequence UNIQUE (workspace_id, sequence)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_dispatches (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	intent_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	registered_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_dispatch_identity CHECK (fence > 0 AND registered_at_ms > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_execution_intents (attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_intents (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	intent_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	domain_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	staging_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_intent_fence CHECK (fence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id), 
	UNIQUE (intent_hash), 
	UNIQUE (domain_id), 
	UNIQUE (staging_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_leases (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	worker_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	producer_host VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	producer_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	producer_birth VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	claimed_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lease_until_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	active_slot INTEGER, 
	released_at_ms BIGINT, result_only BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, pause_requested BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_execution_global_slot UNIQUE (active_slot), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_identity CHECK (fence > 0 AND producer_pid > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_times CHECK (claimed_at_ms > 0 AND heartbeat_at_ms >= claimed_at_ms AND lease_until_ms > heartbeat_at_ms AND (released_at_ms IS NULL OR released_at_ms >= claimed_at_ms)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_active_slot CHECK ((released_at_ms IS NULL AND active_slot = 1 AND active_slot IS NOT NULL) OR (released_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND active_slot IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_receipts (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_receipt_bytes CHECK (result_bytes > 0 AND result_bytes <= 16777216), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_execution_intents (attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_messages (
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32), 
	role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	content_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_message_role CHECK (role IN ('user','assistant','tool','system')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES research_sessions (id)

CREATE TABLE research_no_dispatch_receipts (

	producer_birth VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	released_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_no_dispatch_identity CHECK (fence > 0 AND producer_pid > 0 AND released_at_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_no_dispatch_state CHECK (state IN ('cancelled','interrupted')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_policies" (

	PRIMARY KEY (id),

	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_provider_configurations (

	namespace VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id),

	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (namespace)

CREATE TABLE research_provider_events (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entity_kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	previous_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	chain_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	hash_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	affected_ratio FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	threshold_json TEXT, 
	observed_value_json TEXT, 
	remediation TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quality_run_id) REFERENCES quality_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE quality_runs (
	dataset_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	profile_id CHAR(32), 
	status VARCHAR(21) NOT NULL, 
	ruleset_version VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	threshold_config_json TEXT, 
	dataset_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	error_code VARCHAR(100), 
	error_message TEXT, 
	total_rules INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	passed_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	warning_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	failed_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	skipped_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	overall_score FLOAT, 
	score_json TEXT, 
	ohlcv_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sampled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(255), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(dataset_id) REFERENCES datasets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(profile_id) REFERENCES dataset_profiles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE research_advisory_receipts (
	charge_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	document_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	approved_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	resumed_revision INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (charge_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_advisory_epoch CHECK (approved_revision >= 0 AND (resumed_revision IS NULL OR resumed_revision = approved_revision + 1)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(charge_id) REFERENCES research_charges (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_approvals" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	policy_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	consumed_charge_id CHAR(32), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_expiry CHECK (expires_at_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_approval_proposal UNIQUE (run_id, proposal_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','approved','denied','revoked','consumed')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_consumed CHECK ((state = 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NOT NULL) OR (state != 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(policy_id) REFERENCES research_policies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_artifact_edges (
	parent_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	child_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	relation VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_artifact_no_self_edge CHECK (parent_id != child_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(child_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_artifact_edge UNIQUE (parent_id, child_id, relation)
)

CREATE TABLE research_artifacts (
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	project_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(127) NOT NULL, 
	byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	object_key VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_artifact_nonempty CHECK (byte_size > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id), 
	UNIQUE (object_key)
)

CREATE TABLE research_attachments (
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	target_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_project_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attachment_version_required CHECK ((target_kind = 'project' AND target_sha256 IS NULL) OR (target_kind != 'project' AND target_sha256 IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attachment_kind CHECK (target_kind IN ('project','dataset_version','artifact')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES research_sessions (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attachment UNIQUE (session_id, target_kind, target_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_attempts" (
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(100), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	retry_key VARCHAR(200), 
	base_revision INTEGER, 
	domain_kind VARCHAR(30), 
	domain_run_id CHAR(32), 
	completion_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_state CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval','paused','cancel_requested','completed','failed','cancelled','interrupted')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_number UNIQUE (run_id, number), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_positive CHECK (number > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_retry_key UNIQUE (run_id, retry_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_budget_accounts" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	scope_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	cost_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempt_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_scope CHECK (scope_kind IN ('owner','project','workspace','run')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_hard_limits CHECK (reserved_cost + consumed_cost <= cost_limit AND attempts <= attempt_limit AND reserved_tokens + consumed_tokens <= token_limit AND reserved_ms + consumed_ms <= time_limit_ms), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_budget_scope UNIQUE (owner_id, scope_kind, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_nonnegative CHECK (cost_limit > 0 AND attempt_limit > 0 AND token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0 AND reserved_cost >= 0 AND consumed_cost >= 0 AND attempts >= 0 AND reserved_tokens >= 0 AND consumed_tokens >= 0 AND reserved_ms >= 0 AND consumed_ms >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_charges" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	approval_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	call_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	account_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	specification_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	input_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	output_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	used_cost BIGINT, 
	used_tokens BIGINT, 
	used_ms BIGINT, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	settlement_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_charge_call UNIQUE (run_id, call_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_limits CHECK ((used_cost IS NULL OR (used_cost >= 0 AND used_cost <= reserved_cost)) AND (used_tokens IS NULL OR (used_tokens >= 0 AND used_tokens <= input_token_limit + output_token_limit)) AND (used_ms IS NULL OR (used_ms >= 0 AND used_ms <= time_limit_ms))), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_reservation CHECK (reserved_cost > 0 AND input_token_limit > 0 AND output_token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_proof CHECK ((state IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NOT NULL AND used_tokens IS NOT NULL AND used_ms IS NOT NULL AND settlement_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (state NOT IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NULL AND used_tokens IS NULL AND used_ms IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','dispatched','unknown','settled','released')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES research_approvals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_credential_operations (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	namespace VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	configuration_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	result_code VARCHAR(40), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, producer_instance VARCHAR(80), producer_pid INTEGER, producer_birth VARCHAR(64), lease_until_ms BIGINT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_credential_kind CHECK (kind IN ('create','delete')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_credential_state CHECK (state IN ('intent','confirmed','cleanup_pending','failed','deleted')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_events (
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entity_kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	previous_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	chain_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	hash_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_event_positive CHECK (sequence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES research_workspaces (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_event_sequence UNIQUE (workspace_id, sequence)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_dispatches (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	intent_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	registered_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_dispatch_identity CHECK (fence > 0 AND registered_at_ms > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_execution_intents (attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_intents (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	intent_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	domain_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	staging_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_intent_fence CHECK (fence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id), 
	UNIQUE (intent_hash), 
	UNIQUE (domain_id), 
	UNIQUE (staging_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_leases (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	worker_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	producer_host VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	producer_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	producer_birth VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	claimed_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lease_until_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	active_slot INTEGER, 
	released_at_ms BIGINT, result_only BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, pause_requested BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_execution_global_slot UNIQUE (active_slot), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_identity CHECK (fence > 0 AND producer_pid > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_times CHECK (claimed_at_ms > 0 AND heartbeat_at_ms >= claimed_at_ms AND lease_until_ms > heartbeat_at_ms AND (released_at_ms IS NULL OR released_at_ms >= claimed_at_ms)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_active_slot CHECK ((released_at_ms IS NULL AND active_slot = 1 AND active_slot IS NOT NULL) OR (released_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND active_slot IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_receipts (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_receipt_bytes CHECK (result_bytes > 0 AND result_bytes <= 16777216), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_execution_intents (attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_harness_threads (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,

	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	profile_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	binding_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id),

	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id), 
	UNIQUE (thread_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_messages (
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32),

	content_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_message_role CHECK (role IN ('user','assistant','tool','system')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES research_sessions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_no_dispatch_receipts (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	intent_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	worker_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	producer_host VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	producer_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	producer_birth VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	released_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_no_dispatch_identity CHECK (fence > 0 AND producer_pid > 0 AND released_at_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_no_dispatch_state CHECK (state IN ('cancelled','interrupted')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_policies" (
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES research_workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_provider_configurations (

	namespace VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	key_state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE research_provider_events (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entity_kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	logical_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	previous_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	chain_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	hash_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_provider_event_sequence CHECK (sequence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id),

CREATE TABLE research_provider_states (

	current_id CHAR(32),

	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,

	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_publication_intents (

	result_json TEXT NOT NULL,

	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_execution_receipts (attempt_id), 
	UNIQUE (root_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_publication_receipts (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	plan_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	root_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	publication_fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_publication_fence CHECK (publication_fence > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_publication_state CHECK (state IN ('completed','failed')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_publication_intents (attempt_id), 
	UNIQUE (root_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_runs (
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	input_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	domain_kind VARCHAR(30), 
	domain_run_id CHAR(32), 
	completion_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_completed_proof CHECK (state != 'completed' OR (completion_hash IS NOT NULL AND domain_run_id IS NOT NULL AND domain_kind IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_run_state CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval','paused','cancel_requested','completed','failed','cancelled','interrupted')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_run_counters CHECK (revision >= 0 AND attempt_count >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES research_sessions (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_run_idempotency UNIQUE (session_id, idempotency_key)
)

CREATE TABLE research_sessions (

)

CREATE TABLE research_workspaces (

	project_id CHAR(32), 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	is_deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	event_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,

	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE stat_findings (

)

CREATE TABLE statistical_results (
	analysis_run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	statistic FLOAT,

	confidence_interval_json TEXT, 
	assumption_checks_json TEXT, 
	result_json TEXT, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,

)

	methodset_version VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

	input_config_json TEXT, 
	missing_value_policy VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

	error_code VARCHAR(100), 
	error_message TEXT, 
	created_by VARCHAR(255), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

	resumed_revision INTEGER,

	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id),

	policy_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	consumed_charge_id CHAR(32), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_expiry CHECK (expires_at_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_approval_proposal UNIQUE (run_id, proposal_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','approved','denied','revoked','consumed')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_consumed CHECK ((state = 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NOT NULL) OR (state != 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(policy_id) REFERENCES research_policies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_budget_accounts" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	scope_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	cost_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempt_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_scope CHECK (scope_kind IN ('owner','project','workspace','run')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_hard_limits CHECK (reserved_cost + consumed_cost <= cost_limit AND attempts <= attempt_limit AND reserved_tokens + consumed_tokens <= token_limit AND reserved_ms + consumed_ms <= time_limit_ms), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_budget_scope UNIQUE (owner_id, scope_kind, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_nonnegative CHECK (cost_limit > 0 AND attempt_limit > 0 AND token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0 AND reserved_cost >= 0 AND consumed_cost >= 0 AND attempts >= 0 AND reserved_tokens >= 0 AND consumed_tokens >= 0 AND reserved_ms >= 0 AND consumed_ms >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_charges" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	approval_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	call_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	account_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	specification_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	input_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	output_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	used_cost BIGINT, 
	used_tokens BIGINT, 
	used_ms BIGINT, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	settlement_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_charge_call UNIQUE (run_id, call_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_limits CHECK ((used_cost IS NULL OR (used_cost >= 0 AND used_cost <= reserved_cost)) AND (used_tokens IS NULL OR (used_tokens >= 0 AND used_tokens <= input_token_limit + output_token_limit)) AND (used_ms IS NULL OR (used_ms >= 0 AND used_ms <= time_limit_ms))), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_reservation CHECK (reserved_cost > 0 AND input_token_limit > 0 AND output_token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_proof CHECK ((state IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NOT NULL AND used_tokens IS NOT NULL AND used_ms IS NOT NULL AND settlement_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (state NOT IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NULL AND used_tokens IS NULL AND used_ms IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','dispatched','unknown','settled','released')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES research_approvals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_advisory_receipts (

	approved_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	resumed_revision INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (charge_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_advisory_epoch CHECK (approved_revision >= 0 AND (resumed_revision IS NULL OR resumed_revision = approved_revision + 1)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(charge_id) REFERENCES research_charges (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id),

)

CREATE TABLE "research_approvals" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	policy_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	consumed_charge_id CHAR(32), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_expiry CHECK (expires_at_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_approval_proposal UNIQUE (run_id, proposal_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','approved','denied','revoked','consumed')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_approval_consumed CHECK ((state = 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NOT NULL) OR (state != 'consumed' AND consumed_charge_id IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(policy_id) REFERENCES research_policies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

	FOREIGN KEY(child_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_artifact_edge UNIQUE (parent_id, child_id, relation)
)

	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attachment_version_required CHECK ((target_kind = 'project' AND target_sha256 IS NULL) OR (target_kind != 'project' AND target_sha256 IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attachment_kind CHECK (target_kind IN ('project','dataset_version','artifact')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES research_sessions (id),

)

CREATE TABLE "research_attempts" (

	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(100),

	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL,

	base_revision INTEGER, 
	domain_kind VARCHAR(30), 
	domain_run_id CHAR(32), 
	completion_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_state CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval','paused','cancel_requested','completed','failed','cancelled','interrupted')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_number UNIQUE (run_id, number), 
	CONSTRAINT research_attempt_positive CHECK (number > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_attempt_retry_key UNIQUE (run_id, retry_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_budget_accounts" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	scope_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	cost_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempt_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	consumed_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_scope CHECK (scope_kind IN ('owner','project','workspace','run')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_hard_limits CHECK (reserved_cost + consumed_cost <= cost_limit AND attempts <= attempt_limit AND reserved_tokens + consumed_tokens <= token_limit AND reserved_ms + consumed_ms <= time_limit_ms), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_budget_scope UNIQUE (owner_id, scope_kind, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_budget_nonnegative CHECK (cost_limit > 0 AND attempt_limit > 0 AND token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0 AND reserved_cost >= 0 AND consumed_cost >= 0 AND attempts >= 0 AND reserved_tokens >= 0 AND consumed_tokens >= 0 AND reserved_ms >= 0 AND consumed_ms >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_charges" (
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	approval_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	call_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	account_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	specification_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_cost BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	input_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	output_token_limit BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	time_limit_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	used_cost BIGINT, 
	used_tokens BIGINT, 
	used_ms BIGINT, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	settlement_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_charge_call UNIQUE (run_id, call_key), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_limits CHECK ((used_cost IS NULL OR (used_cost >= 0 AND used_cost <= reserved_cost)) AND (used_tokens IS NULL OR (used_tokens >= 0 AND used_tokens <= input_token_limit + output_token_limit)) AND (used_ms IS NULL OR (used_ms >= 0 AND used_ms <= time_limit_ms))), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_reservation CHECK (reserved_cost > 0 AND input_token_limit > 0 AND output_token_limit > 0 AND time_limit_ms > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_usage_proof CHECK ((state IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NOT NULL AND used_tokens IS NOT NULL AND used_ms IS NOT NULL AND settlement_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (state NOT IN ('settled','released') AND used_cost IS NULL AND used_tokens IS NULL AND used_ms IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_charge_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','dispatched','unknown','settled','released')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES research_approvals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_credential_operations (

	CONSTRAINT research_credential_kind CHECK (kind IN ('create','delete')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_credential_state CHECK (state IN ('intent','confirmed','cleanup_pending','failed','deleted')),

)

)

	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id),

	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_execution_intents (attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_intents (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	intent_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	domain_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	staging_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_intent_fence CHECK (fence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id),

	UNIQUE (domain_id), 
	UNIQUE (staging_id)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_leases (
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	worker_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	producer_host VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	producer_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	producer_birth VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	claimed_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lease_until_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	active_slot INTEGER, 
	released_at_ms BIGINT, result_only BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, pause_requested BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_execution_global_slot UNIQUE (active_slot), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_identity CHECK (fence > 0 AND producer_pid > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_times CHECK (claimed_at_ms > 0 AND heartbeat_at_ms >= claimed_at_ms AND lease_until_ms > heartbeat_at_ms AND (released_at_ms IS NULL OR released_at_ms >= claimed_at_ms)), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_active_slot CHECK ((released_at_ms IS NULL AND active_slot = 1 AND active_slot IS NOT NULL) OR (released_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND active_slot IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_attempts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_execution_receipts (

	manifest_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT research_execution_receipt_bytes CHECK (result_bytes > 0 AND result_bytes <= 16777216), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES research_execution_intents (attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "research_harness_threads" (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	thread_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	profile_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	binding_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	finish_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	finish_checkpoint_id VARCHAR(128), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_research_harness_attempt_purpose UNIQUE (attempt_id, purpose), 
	CONSTRAINT research_harness_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('business','assistant')), 
	CONSTRAINT research_harness_finish_pair CHECK ((finish_hash IS NULL AND finish_checkpoint_id IS NULL) OR (finish_hash IS NOT NULL AND finish_checkpoint_id IS NOT NULL)),
